 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: On The 6 th Of October, 2025
Misc .
Criminal Case No. 15062 of 2025

Rahul And Others
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
Appearance:
Shri Prakhar Naveriya - Advocate for the applicants.
Shri C.M. Tiwari - Government Advocate for State.

Order 
This is the fourth application under Section 483 of B.N.S.S. for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.394/2023 registered at Police Station Athner, District Betul (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 376(DA), 376(3), 506 of IPC, Section 3/4/5(G)/6 of POCSO Act and Sections 3(2)(va), 3(2)(v), 3(1)(w)(ii) of SC/ST Act.
The applicants are in custody since 05.10.2023.
Previous bail applications were dismissed as withdrawn.
2. As per the prosecution story, the allegation against applicants is that they committed rape with the minor prosecutrix.
On the basis of which, offence has been registered against the applicants under the aforesaid sections.
3. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that applicants are innocent and have been falsely implicated in the present case.
They are in NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:50305 2 MCRC-15062-2025 custody since 05.10.2023.
Prosecutrix in her cross-examination has not supported the prosecution story.
Date of birth of the prosecutrix is not proved as per legal provision.
The conclusion of trial will take considerable time.
Hence, it is prayed that the applicants may be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the bail application and has submitted that at the time of incident, prosecutrix was below 13 years.

In her examination-in-chief,
she has completely supported the prosecution story but her cross-examination was deferred in which she has not supported the prosecution story.
Other witnesses have deposed against the present applicants and supported the prosecution story.
In this case, gang rape was committed with minor prosecutrix.
It is further submitted that minute appreciation of evidence cannot be done at this stage.
Hence, the applicants do not deserve grant of bail.

6. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case as well as act of applicants, I am not inclined to grant regular bail to the applicants.
7. Accordingly, present MCRC stands dismissed.
